place.zh: 沉鼎观 · 大比 · 第一轮
place.en: Chending Temple · The contest · Round one

setup.zh: 第一轮，你的对手是孙二狗。他上台的时候，腿在抖：「咱俩……都是下下之资……你手下留情……」
setup.en: Round one: your opponent is Sun Ergou. His legs shake as he climbs up. "We're both… the bottom of the class… go easy on me…"

recap.zh: 大比第一轮，你的对手是孙二狗。
recap.en: In the first round of the contest you faced Sun Ergou.

zh: 他腿在抖。腰上，他娘缝的护身符。
en: His legs shake. At his waist, the charm his mother sewed.

story.zh:
孙二狗便是上山路上，在那个漏风的牛棚里分了小满半张饼的那个瘦高个儿。他后来也考进来了，灵根比小满还差，测灵石亮起来的时候执事还当是石头坏了，伸手拍了两下。进门三个月，别人引气的引气，挨打的挨打，他什么都没引着，也没什么人肯打他——打他实在没有意思。他每天夜里坐在大通铺的最里头打坐，打到后半夜，打着打着便睡着了，睡着了也坐得笔直，第二天醒来，脖子歪着，照旧坐得笔直。

上台的时候，他腿在抖。一看对手是小满，抖得更厉害了——倒不是怕，是松了一口气，松得太猛，腿便软了。他挨到小满跟前，压低了声音道：「沈……沈师兄……咱俩……都是下下之资……你……你手下留情……」

小满也压低了声音：「你先出手。」

小满瞧见他腰里系着一个小小的布包，蓝布的，四个角缝得方方正正，针脚密得像蚂蚁排队，一针挨着一针，挨得连一根头发丝也插不进去。小满他娘也是缝东西的好手，小满打小看她缝，看得多了，一眼便估得出一件活计要缝几个晚上：这样的针脚，这样大的一块，是油灯底下三个晚上的活，一个晚上缝一个角，第四个角缝到天亮。

那是一个护身符。
story.en:
Sun Ergou was the lanky boy who, on the road up the mountain, in that drafty cowshed, had shared half a flatbread with Xiaoman. He had passed the test too, with roots worse even than Xiaoman's; when the testing stone lit up for him the steward thought it was broken and slapped it twice. Three months in, others had drawn qi or taken beatings; he had drawn nothing, and nobody much cared to beat him — there was no fun in it. Every night he sat at the far end of the big dormitory bunk meditating till past midnight, and fell asleep at it, and asleep still sat bolt upright; next morning he'd wake with a crick in his neck, still bolt upright.

Going up on the stage, his legs shook. When he saw it was Xiaoman they shook worse — not from fear, but from relief, so sudden his knees gave. He sidled up and whispered: "Br… Brother Shen… we're… both bottom of the bottom… go… go easy on me…"

Xiaoman whispered back: "You strike first."

Xiaoman noticed a small cloth bag tied at his waist, blue cloth, its four corners sewn square, the stitches close as marching ants, one against the next, so tight not a hair could go between. Xiaoman's mother was a fine hand with a needle too; he had watched her sew since he was small, watched so much he could tell at a glance how many evenings a piece of work had taken: stitches like these, a piece this size — three evenings under the oil lamp, one corner an evening, the fourth corner sewn till dawn.

It was a charm.

exits.means: loses on purpose, lets Sun Ergou win

refuse.zh: 你看着孙二狗发抖的腿。你不知道他为什么这么想赢一场。
refuse.en: You look at Sun Ergou's shaking legs. You don't know why he wants one win so badly.

what.zh: 外门大比第一轮，你往后一倒，让孙二狗赢了他入观以来的第一场。
what.en: Round one of the contest: you fell backwards and let Sun Ergou win the first bout of his life in the temple.

story.zh:
孙二狗闭上眼睛，一拳打了过来。那一拳软绵绵的，没有一点力气，拳头离小满鼻尖还差着老大一截，小满已「哎呀——」一声大叫，往后便倒，脚下一绊，身子一歪，四仰八叉地摔出了台子，摔得结结实实，连台下的尘土都扬起来半尺高。

台下一片寂静。

跟着便是一阵哄笑，笑得最响的是马小宝，他站在台下头一排，笑得桂花糕渣子从嘴里喷出来，喷了前头人一后脑勺，一面笑一面拍着大腿道：「我就说！我就说！五行杂灵根，连个零层都打不过！」他那五个跟班跟着笑，笑得前仰后合。小满躺在地上，望着天，心想：笑吧，笑的人越多越好。

孙二狗睁开眼睛，看看自己的拳头，又看看台下的小满，满脸茫然，仿佛不太认得自己这只手了。执事沉默了很久，久到台下有人咳嗽了一声，才道：「……孙二狗，胜。」

孙二狗就这么晋了级。这是他入观以来头一回赢，站在台上，愣了一会儿，然后低下头去，摸了摸腰里那个蓝布包，眼泪便啪嗒啪嗒掉了下来，掉在五行台的青石板上，一滴一个圆点。他哭得像个孩子，一面哭一面还冲台下的小满鞠了一个躬，鞠得太深，差点又一头栽下去。

小满在台下爬起来，拍了拍身上的土。

阿禾不知什么时候站到了他身边，面无表情地道：「你输了。」

小满说：「嗯。」

阿禾道：「你是故意的。」

小满说：「他腰里那个护身符，是他娘缝的。三个晚上。」

阿禾道：「你怎么知道是三个晚上？」

小满说：「针脚数得出来。」

阿禾看了他很久，掏出小本子，写了一行。这一回，她没告诉他写的是什么。
story.en:
Sun Ergou shut his eyes and threw a punch. A limp punch with no strength in it; his fist was still a long way from Xiaoman's nose when Xiaoman gave a great yell — "Aiya—!" — and went over backwards, tripped on his own feet, and sprawled clean off the stage, landing solidly enough to raise the dust half a foot below.

Dead silence below.

Then a burst of laughter, loudest of all from Ma Xiaobao, standing in the front row below, laughing so hard osmanthus crumbs sprayed from his mouth over the back of the head in front of him, slapping his thigh: "Told you! Told you! Mixed five roots — can't even beat a zero!" His five followers laughed along, doubling up. Xiaoman lay on the ground looking at the sky and thought: laugh. The more laugh, the better.

Sun Ergou opened his eyes, looked at his fist, then at Xiaoman below, utterly lost, as if he didn't quite recognise his own hand. The steward was silent a long while, long enough for someone below to cough, then said: "…Sun Ergou wins."

So Sun Ergou went through. It was his first win since joining the temple. He stood on the stage in a daze a moment, then bowed his head and touched the blue cloth bag at his waist, and the tears came pattering down onto the bluestone of the Five Elements Platform, one drop, one round mark. He cried like a child, and as he cried he bowed to Xiaoman below — bowed so deep he nearly pitched off the stage too.

Below, Xiaoman got up and dusted himself off.

Ah He, who had come to stand beside him at some point, said without expression, "You lost."

"Mm," said Xiaoman.

"You did it on purpose."

"That charm at his waist — his mother sewed it. Three evenings."

"How do you know it was three evenings?"

"You can count the stitches."

Ah He looked at him a long time, took out her notebook, and wrote a line. This time she didn't tell him what she wrote.

withdrawn.zh: 孙二狗还站着，腿抖得更厉害了。——再来。
withdrawn.en: Sun Ergou is still standing, legs shaking harder than ever. — Again.

story.zh:
孙二狗闭上眼睛，一拳打了过来。那一拳软绵绵的，没有一点力气。

小满看了一眼他腰里那个护身符，又看了一眼他发抖的腿，心里叹了口气，一侧身，让过了那一拳。
story.en:
Sun Ergou shut his eyes and threw a punch. A limp punch with no strength in it.

Xiaoman glanced at the charm at his waist, then at his shaking legs, sighed inwardly, and turned aside to let the punch go by.
